motion_start_method: First nonzero planar/yaw velocity in the contiguous ramp leading to three packets above 0.02 m/s or 0.03 rad/s.
trim_method: Remove earlier packets; preserve session, timestamps and payloads; restart each stream sequence at 1 for SDK replay compatibility.
limitations: No camera frames with matching final-capture sessions were found.
Contiguous saved sequences do not prove every upstream sensor frame arrived or that the intended trial finished.
Usable gaze means a finite nonzero vector and finite overlap, not validated eye contact. Suspected default bundles are UNKNOWN for this audit; this does not modify live policy.
Gaze high/low counts are instantaneous diagnostics, not temporal gaze categories or time fractions.
Intent labels require independent observation; sensor agreement is not behavioral ground truth.

scenarios.assessment: Closing and disappearance are compatible with passing, but gaze is mostly high until late. Human passing is not established by relative distance alone.
Sustained high gaze at 2.11–2.56 m, within approach distance. Two perception packets contain duplicate entries for the same UID; one gaze vector is unavailable.
Sustained high gaze, but starts around 1.7 m, outside the configured 1.5 m interaction range; reaches that range later.
Closing and final disappearance, but frequent high gaze and many unavailable estimates do not support a clean no-look pass.
No detected person in any post-motion perception frame; walking away and gaze cannot be assessed.
High gaze occurs across most of the recorded pass, with almost no usable low gaze. The file ends without a reliable look-ahead-again phase or completion of the pass.
Alternating high and low usable gaze is compatible with intermittent attention, but detection/default-gaze gaps and UID changes break continuity. Standing to the side is unverified.
Relative separation grows from about 1.12 to 2.10 m, consistent with moving away. Continuous looking is not supported: many low or unavailable gaze estimates, and an initial no-detection period.
Looking is supported at roughly 2.0–2.4 m. No gesture or path-relation measurements, and no matching video, establish the pass gesture or placement in front of the route.
